purpose: Convert the factory from prototype-and-doc output into a secure, measurable, billable production business.

p0_layers.proof: login, invites, role checks, tenant isolation tests and audited admin access
p0_layers.next_action: implement auth service and permission middleware against core_v1 API

p0_layers.proof: migration applies cleanly, RLS tests pass, stock and payment idempotency tests pass
p0_layers.next_action: add migration runner, seed permissions and database integration tests

p0_layers.proof: trial to paid, renewal, failed payment, cancellation, invoice and reconciliation flows
p0_layers.next_action: implement one provider adapter plus manual bank-payment fallback

p0_layers.proof: tenant-isolated upload, validation, thumbnails, 25-photo part test and deletion audit
p0_layers.next_action: create signed upload API and asynchronous image processing jobs

p0_layers.proof: retry, dead-letter, idempotency, marketplace sync and invoice job tests
p0_layers.next_action: implement worker runtime and dead-letter queue

p0_layers.proof: structured logs, metrics, traces, uptime alert, incident owner, rollback and postmortem
p0_layers.next_action: add health endpoints, error tracking, service dashboards and incident runbook

p0_layers.proof: encrypted backup, documented RPO/RTO and successful restore drill
p0_layers.next_action: create automated database and object-storage backup with restore test

p0_layers.proof: activation, usage, listing-to-sale, churn, MRR, gross margin and model cost dashboards
p0_layers.next_action: define event contract and instrument first seller workflow

p0_layers.proof: self-serve onboarding, checklist completion, support SLA, renewal and churn reason
p0_layers.next_action: build onboarding checklist and support/retention state machine

p0_layers.proof: terms acceptance, privacy consent, export, retention, account closure and deletion logs
p0_layers.next_action: create versioned consent and data lifecycle model

p0_layers.proof: tenant-scoped flags, staged rollout, rollback, migration gate and release evidence
p0_layers.next_action: implement feature flag registry and release checklist in CI

p0_layers.proof: one import/export connector, stock reservation, retry, reconciliation and failure queue
p0_layers.next_action: ship CSV connector first, then one real marketplace connector

release_gate: No customer data or payment may enter production until tenant isolation, audit logging, backup restore and monitoring tests pass.
business_gate: No product counts as launched until a buyer can sign up, reach value, pay, receive support and renew without founder-only manual intervention.
